_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.title: Graded coverage across ten families
requirements.description: Serve at least 40 data-defined levels, with at least four each for tables, pagination/deep links, search, script-loaded/endless scroll, sessions, downloads, messy markup, changing layouts, rate/errors/timeouts, and owned-ground bot checks.

validation.notes: Test file contains [REQ:EXTRACTI-P0-001] evidence for this behavior.

requirements.title: Known-answer scoring and tool scoreboard
requirements.description: Hold an expected answer for each level; score submitted records deterministically, prevent duplicate inflation, and keep the best per-tool/per-level score with precision, recall, F1 and pass status.

validation.notes: Test file contains [REQ:EXTRACTI-P0-002] evidence for this behavior.

requirements.title: Reachable owned practice pages
requirements.description: Serve each challenge's requested target behavior through lifecycle-managed local pages and publish a stable task/API contract without exposing held answers in level metadata.

validation.notes: Test file contains [REQ:EXTRACTI-P0-003] evidence for this behavior.
